Game.Name: Touhou Blooming Chaos 2
Game.Overview: Touhou Blooming Chaos 2Â isÂ anÂ brandÂ newÂ rogueÂ shooterÂ whereÂ youÂ controlÂ a character of a varied castÂ toÂ exploreÂ an all randomized labyrinth.Â EnjoyÂ theÂ excessiveÂ funÂ ofÂ reapingÂ enemiesÂ andÂ character training. With balanced difficulty, you can always find your place as either beginner or veteran!

Game.Name: Touhou Chireiden: Subterranean Animism.
Game.Overview: The more hellish the barrage is, the more beautiful it is. The deeper you go, the more hellish the underground becomes. A hellish and lovely bullet-hell shooting hell.

Game.Name: Touhou Choseisho: Sapphire Panlogism
Game.Overview:
"Gensokyo has been dealing with an unusual drizzle as of late. Somehow, saltwater is raining down from the sky in large quantities. Just what kind of person could be causing this, and for what reason...?"
The game's main mechanic is the Rainbowl system. Throughout the game, the player will encounter enemies with red or green auras surrounding them. This aura will turn blue after a while, making the enemy more vulnerable in return. Should you defeat that enemy, it will drop small, raindrop-shaped items that are colored red, green, or blue depending on the aura of the defeated enemy. Droplets collected by the player are added to the Rainbowl, which is shown on the right side of the screen.
During spell card attacks, bosses will have their own auras, which will cycle through the three colors. In addition to droplets of the aura's color at the time of clearing the spell card, the boss will also drop a life or spell piece. (Note: Droplets will not be automatically collected when the player crosses the point of collection.)
Collecting 10 droplets of the same color will activate a Rain Border. The rewards are different depending on the border's color when it ends:
Red borders offer life pieces. Green borders offer spell pieces. Blue borders offer extra PIV (point item value) items. If the player collects 10 droplets of another type while a border is active, the border will be refreshed and become a new color based on the combination of droplet types. The more colors comprising a border, the more score and resources the player will obtain. In other words, individual combined borders are more valuable than multiple single-color borders.
Releasing the Z key when a border is active will allow the player to automatically collect all on-screen items and award a corresponding score bonus, with a multiplier based on the amount of colors active. The border will become inactive during boss dialogue scenes, and item collection will automatically activate once the battle is over.

Game.Name: Touhou Danmakufu: Concealed the Conclusion
Game.Overview:
Concealed the Conclusion (Touhou Mushuugeki) is a huge script set for Touhou Danmakufu. It is the second game in Danmaq's alternative Touhou series, and has massive improvements over the first.
In Gensokyo, a rather weak spring is blooming. The flowers are weak, the youkai are rather calm, and Gensokyo seems to be in a slump. Marisa Kirisame, a scheming magician, is brewing up some new magic. However, unlike her normal magic, this isn't for fighting, it's for viewing flowers. She goes over to Reimu Hakurei, to show her. However, when she shows up at the shrine, nobody is there, and it's locked up. A tragic story of Gensokyo has quickly begun. There are four separate scenarios to choose from, changing the first 3 stages.
sources : touhou.wikia.com

Game.Name: Touhou Doumeiju Mystical Power Plant
Game.Overview:
Written by Oyasu Milka, the story centers around a giant tree that Kanako Yasaka has brought to the Youkai Mountain from the Outside World. She intended for said tree to serve as a symbol of Gensokyo's newfound age of ecology, and it was called the "Life-Guiding Tree" to reflect this. However, during the opening celebration, a mysterious light appeared around the top of the tree, giving off a strange power.
The main theme of the story is Sugawara no Michizane, a famous scholar and poet who came to be revered as a god after his death.

Game.Name: Touhou Endless Dream
Game.Overview: A bullet hell roguelike game. Players can utilize characters with different abilities, collect and assemble powerful items. Dance through an unending barrage of bullets to save both yourself and Touhou Gensokyo from the darkness that is engulfing everything.

Game.Name: Touhou Fantasia / ä¸œæ–¹æ¢¦æƒ³æ›²
Game.Overview: This is a fan-made Touhou shmup with one single stage, similar to the extra stage of official Touhou games. This game has an auto dodging system, which gives you a choice to ignore all the danmaku and only focus on the story.

Game.Name: Touhou Fugyouseki: Nightmare of Sleeping Girl
Game.Overview: A mist is spreading, causing locals in Gensokyo to fall into a deep endless sleep. Yukari gathers and guides the few remaining souls who remain awake to fight their way through endless waves of enemies as they wake up their friends and bring down the mastermind of this whole incident

Game.Name: Touhou Fumo Racing
Game.Overview:
Embody a Fumo and compete on a wacky karting race against other fumo-fied Touhou Characters! Play alone against AI-controlled racers or with up to 4 friends on splitscreen multiplayer.
Dev's note
-"Touhou Fumo Racing is in early stage of development and there are a lot of features and things to do, so expect bugs, missing features and a small amount of content. Besides that, the game is currently playable and I hope that everyone who plays it, being a Touhou Fan or not, has an enjoyable experience."
This game is a fan-work of Touhou Project
Touhou Project belongs to Team Shangai Alice ( ZUN ), Touhou Project "FumoFumo" designed by ROYALCAT, products from GIFT.
They are NOT affiliated with this fan game. All content is the property of their respective owners.

Game.Overview: Venture into dungeons with a huge party of your favorite Touhou characters! This is a dungeon-crawler RPG with an absurdly large party size! Lead tons of your favorite Touhou characters at once and conquer the impregnable Lotus Labyrinth dungeon!

Game.Name: Touhou Genso Wanderer: Reloaded
Game.Overview: Based on the "Touhou Project" world, Touhou Genso Wanderer -Reloaded- is an addictive roguelike RPG that's easy for beginners to pickup and play, but with tons of advanced options for pros! Explore dungeons with your Touhou favorites characters, collect loot, and battle over the Golden Spheres!

Game.Name: TouhouÂ HeroÂ ofÂ IceÂ Fairy
Game.Overview: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy is an indie game developed by GAMEPULSE.Step into the shoes of Cirno, the Hero of Ice, as she embarks on a journey against evil, liberating Gensokyo and saving her dear princess.

Use your head, I mean, if you have enough money, why not settle those annoying problems by just thrusting money to the man behind all these? Well then, it's a damn good idea that let that Reimu pay. Actually, she did pay! ***What the hell was going on? There's only one thing I know - She earned all those money, by doing real estate business !***

Game.Name: Touhou Kouryudou: Unconnected Marketeers.
Game.Overview: Buy, sell, receive, let go! Since when did humans misunderstand that they can freely handle property rights? A rainbow and immemorial shooting fantasy!

Game.Name: Touhou Luna Nights
Game.Overview:
Touhou Luna Nights is a Metroidvania title with a heavy emphasis on exploration and action. Developed by Team Ladybug, creators of multiple fantastic action games thus far.
â€œ...Now, letâ€™s begin my world.â€ Remilia Scarlet, head vampire of the Scarlet Devil Mansion sends her maid Sakuya Izayoi with no warning to a world much like Gensokyo, but not quite. A world full of strange places, filled with strange youkai and her time manipulation sealed. What could Remiliaâ€™s end game be...? What's special about this game
â€¢ Time stop system from character's Ability and Gimmick maps that use special abilities like time stop.
â€¢ Adapt the "graze" system of the Touhou Project into a 2D game, giving you a sense of tension in approaching to the enemy.

Game.Name: TouHou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part II
Game.Overview: Touhou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival part II is a danmaku shooting game, which is the second part of Touhou Makuka Sai. The repeat of incident is coming again. Can the girls going to the netherworld solve the mystery?

Game.Name: Touhou Mechanical Scrollery | å¹»æƒ³è¨Žå¹»çµŒ
Game.Overview: A 3D bullet hell mid-air hunting action game based on the Touhou Project. Fly freely through the air and face down humongous foes with both melee action and 3D bullet patterns (Danmaku)!

Game.Name: Touhoumon: Boiling Blood
Game.Overview:
The Swarm Incident that struck Ventri brings the seaborn aberration known as Boneka. They're destroying Ventri and its Pokemon population, turning it into overgrown ruins, and ruling the lands. Explore the post-apocalypse theme Ventri, thwart the Eight Survivors, and survive from Boneka's insatiable wrath. Prove yourself to be The Virtuous One. My own take of HemoglobinA1C's Touhoumon, inspired by Aichiya Sanae's Touhoumon Another World
Features: - All Touhou's Boneka from Highly Responsive to Prayers to Unidentified Fantastic Object - Vanilla type matchup, just like vanilla Pokemon games - Boneka's stats overhaul - ACTUAL PHYSICAL/SPECIAL SPLIT - Better move pools and more ability since Gen 3 which mean more appropriate abilities for everyone! - MORE LAST WORD BONEKA

Game.Name: Touhou Monster TD ~ å¹»æƒ³ä¹¡å¦–æ€ªå¡”é˜²
Game.Overview: Easy to learn but hard to master, Touhou Monster TD is a unique Tower defense Game. Control your character, level up and unlock tower skills and character talents, use your wisdom to defeat incoming enemies. Travel the Gensokyo, find out why the â€œIncidentâ€ happened this time.

Game.Name: Touhou Mother
Game.Overview: Reimu is lazing on the job (again) and without her knowing the Hakurei Border has been deactivated, letting in humans to ruin the dear and beloved land of Gensokyo, your job is to find out who did this and stop them before Gensokyo is completely transformed!

Game.Name: Touhou Multi Scroll Shooting 2
Game.Overview: A derivative work of Touhou project. Featuring dynamic camera. Blend from side scroll shooting and top-down shooting seamlessly.

Game.Name: Touhou Mystery Reel
Game.Overview: Touhou Mystery Reel is a 2D platformer action game with special combat system. You can experience exciting battles and interesting stories in the game. There will be different endings of the stages. The player has the freedom to choose either to fight the powerful bosses or to take "shortcuts".

Game.Name: Touhou Mystia's Izakaya
Game.Overview: A brand new pixel art restaurant simulator based on the Touhou Project! Play as Mystia, the owner of a small izakaya. Collect ingredients by day, cater to the customers by night, learn recipes from familiar characters, and become the best izakaya owner in all of Gensokyo!

Game.Name: Touhou Pocket Wars Evo
Game.Overview: You are an otaku who in their spare time collects Gacha figurines. These have attributes and can be entered into matches with others who also own some figurines. One day, it seems your love for the Gensokyo girls enables you to end up visiting Gensokyo, using your Gachas to help them figure out some problems.

Game.Name: Touhou Puppet Dance Performance
Game.Overview: Gensou Ningyou Enbu (??????, lit. "Fantasy Puppet Dance Performance"), also known unofficially as Touhou Puppet Dance Performance, is a spiritual successor to the PokÃ©mon FireRed hack Touhou Puppet Play, involving training and collecting puppets of various Touhou characters. The game was released at Comiket 87 on December 30th. The developer of the game is doujin circle FocasLens, which consists of HemoglobinA1C, the original developer of the Touhou Puppet Play ROM Hacks. Touhou Puppet Dance Performance, unlike the Touhou Puppet Play ROM Hacks, is an entirely stand alone game, built with its own engine and mechanics, which draw heavy inspiration from the 6th Generation of the Pokemon franchise. The game puts the player in the sealed realm of Gensokyo, where they travel around trying to figure out how to get home and, in the process, deal with an incident of these newfound Puppets which showed up in Gensokyo out of the blue.

Game.Name: Touhou Puppet Play: The Festival of Curses
Game.Overview:
The game itself revolves around the protagonist of the previous game, Ayaka, as she heads out to enjoy the Harvest Festival being held this year. Being the first real Harvest Festival since the advent of the Puppet Era of Gensokyo, the Festival has been changed around a fair bit to accommodate Puppets to celebrate their arrival to the realm- most notably, with a grand Festival Tournament being established for Puppet Handlers throughout the village to partake in... But, of course, as this is Gensokyo, peace doesn't stay for very long. In the shadows, an individual has made moves to disrupt the festivities and bring an end to the Humans coexistence with Puppetkind.
Features: - A Touhoumon game with Puppets up to Double Dealing Character and Urban Legend in Limbo! - A visual style from the creators of Touhoumon themselves, FocasLens, utilizing their Gensou Ningyou Enbu Asset Collection Pack! - Not to mention music from the equally tallented a-TTTempo (from the GNE Ost), and Paradarx (A fairly popular Pokemon-soundfont arranger of Touhou tracks!) - A fair amount of utilization of Golisopod User's Mid-Battle Dialogue/Battle Scripting resource to make some quirky, if hopefully enjoyable, battles!

Game.Name: Touhou Rhythm Carnival! Scarlet
Game.Overview: Aya Shameimaru was finding stories to make into articles for her paper. However, finding fresh and good stories was no easy work. Then she became inclined to go to the Scarlet Devil Mansion she happened to pass by. Aya had a hunch that something interesting was going to happen, so she decided to visit.

Game.Name: Touhou Saikotan: Servants of Harvest Wish
Game.Overview:
Set off on a journey to an autumnal paradise in this bountiful Touhou fan game made by overseas fans!
æ±æ–¹å‚¬ç‹è­š ï½ž Servants of Harvest Wish is a fan-made Touhou Project game made using the Touhou Danmakufu ph3 shooting game engine and is the second game made by Team Dreamcatcher. Servants of Harvest Wish provides quality gameplay, wonderful music, a unique plot and many secrets to be unfold. Join Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sanae Kochiya and Ryouko as they explore various locations to expose the mastermind pulling the strings from behind the scenes.
- Game Introduction - Servants of Harvest Wish is a vertical-scrolling shoot'em-up game with 6 stages + an additional extra stage. The game features a "Harvest Mode" mechanic that cleverly combines both survival and scoring play. Each character has a set of two shot types, plus a unique ability linked to gameplay. This game can be enjoyed from casual players to skilled STG maniacs thanks to the various difficulty levels.
The game features various secrets that can be unlocked through both regular runs and practice runs. Discover all different methods of unlocking Abnormal Barrage Spell Cards, as well as something special for expert players.
- Story - A new incident causes all of the crops throughout Gensokyo to wither right before the harvest season, exposing the Human Village to the threat of famine. Expecting different reasons, the heroines set off to expose the heartless youkai who are behind this incident, but none of them knew what had happened behind the scenes beforehand. Explore all scenarios in order to piece all clues together while enjoying the marvellous gameplay elements inbetween.

Game.Name: Touhou: Scarlet Curiosity
Game.Overview: The world of Touhou comes alive in this beautiful action RPG (featuring â€œbullet hellâ€ elements, of course!). Infamous vampire Remilia Scarlet and her dutiful maid, Sakuya, set off to chase rumors of a massive monster, all while sending baddies flying with fluid action and signature skills!

Game.Name: Touhou Seirensen ~ Undefined Fantastic Object.
Game.Overview: What's that? Is it a bird? Is it a fairy? A mysterious unidentified fantasy object will take you to an unknown world! A fantastic and retro bullet hell shooting fantasy.

Game.Overview: Touhou Sky Arena (æ±æ–¹ã‚¹ã‚«ã‚¤ã‚¢ãƒªãƒ¼ãƒŠ, romanized Touhou Sukai Arina) is a 3D arena fighting game by Area-ZERO, similar in style to Magical Battle Arena, an earlier game by the same doujin circle. Originally set to be released at Reitaisai 8 in March 13, 2011, it was later released at doujin shops in March 19 due to the event being postponed. Two OST CDs were also released.

Game.Name: Touhou Sky Arena: KURENAI
Game.Overview:
Touhou Sky Arena: KURENAI is a sequel to the popular fangame Touhou Sky Arena by Area-ZERO. Originally intended to be a series of patches, it was adapted into a full release and was released on May 27, 2012 at Reitaisai 9. A demo was released during Comiket 81.
KURENAI's gameplay is largely the same as its predecessor. Additions include eight new characters and the inclusion of a Spirit Orb system, which allows the player to equip three orbs to their character, modifying their abilities and stats. There are also new levels, including Bhava-Agra, Bamboo Forest of the Lost, an underground cave (not to be confused with Utsuho's stage in the original Touhou Sky Arena), and the Palanquin Ship.

Game.Name: Touhou Sky Arena Matsuri Climax
Game.Overview: Touhou girls fight dramatic battles in the sky! A 3D fired-up battle action game based on Touhou Project! Features a "Fired-up Battle System", in which characters abilities change to the playing song.

Game.Name: Touhou Soujinengi: The Genius of Sappheiros
Game.Overview: It's a normal day in Gensokyo when Reimu Hakurei notices a strange fog rolling in. All across Gensokyo, residents witness this fog weakening and killing a great many lesser youkai. At the behest of Yukari Yakumo, she joins forces with Marisa Kirisame, Sanae Kochiya, and Aya Shameimaru to investigate the fog's appearance...
