Then, the player builds the shops and after they arrive from nearby warehouses and granaries, a peddler roams the streets, selling his goods until he is sold out (roadblocks can be used to control his path, keeping him in the neighborhood).
Finally, religion plays a larger -and more palpable- part than in previous games. In many missions, the player may be facing a monster summoned by a deity (which requires the player to call a hero such as Heracles by building him a nice building with all required commodities) or the Deity himself, which can cause extreme damage to the city (like Ares or Athena) or lure inhabitants away from the city (Aphrodite). To obtain their favor and blessings, the player first must build a gigantic temple and then offer a sacrifice, even if sometimes they help the player from their own kindness. While in previous games their actions were communicated by message boxes, in Zeus they have their own sprites, roaming across the city.
The rest of the game remains unchanged from the core of the series. The player is in charge of developing a plot of land and turn it into a thriving new city. For that, the player must build enough housing spots and provide jobs for the people, either working in production of raw material, manufacturing of goods or services done to the city. These services include philosophers, athletes and actors, who entertain the people and every four years take part in the Olympic Games, which brings fame to the city. Other services include tax collectors, water bearers, healers, watchmen, and superintendents. Each level (excluding sandbox games) have a goal that may range from stockpiling a number of goods, submitting neighboring cities, or acquire enough currency.

Game.Name: Zeus + Poseidon
Game.Overview:
tart with a plot of land by the shores of the wine-dark Aegean and create a thriving city-state of your own design. Build roads and monuments, set taxes, control trade, and command armies on land and sea. Construct massive sanctuaries, a stadium for the Games, even an Atlantean pyramid. Build armies and fleets to battle neighbors on land and sea. Succeed, and make them your vassals. Fail, and you'll be forced to play tribute until you win back your freedom. Rule the legendary world of Atlantis. Mine orichalc, and make use of unique buildings like bibliotheques and observatories.
Acropolisâ€™ delivers the city-building excitement and strategy of both Zeusâ€™ Master of Olympusâ€™ and Zeusâ€™ Official Expansion Poseidonâ€™. Build great empires, dabble in combat, trade, and politics, and keep monsters like Medusa at bay with the help of great heroes from mythology. Establish new colonies in the ancient Americas, Africa, Europe, and Asia. Create your own adventures with a powerful yet easy to use Adventure Editor.
Youâ€™ll create bustling cities filled with thousands of citizens in mythological Greece and the lost continent of Atlantis. Exercise your might by threatening neighboring cities with invasion, or cultivate them as allies against even stronger opponents. Build beautiful Greek sanctuaries and Atlantean pyramids piece by piece. Summon heroes to rid your town of plagues and monsters, or appease gods and goddesses to protect you from evil.
Acropolisâ€™ delivers hundreds of hours of gameplay in one game!

Game.Name: Zeus + Poseidon (Acropolis)
Game.Overview: Start with a plot of land by the shores of the wine-dark Aegean and create a thriving city-state of your own design. Build roads and monuments, set taxes, control trade, and command armies on land and sea.Construct massive sanctuaries, a stadium for the Games, even an Atlantean pyramid.Build armies and fleets to battle neighbors on land and sea. Succeed, and make them your vassals. Fail, and you'll be forced to play tribute until you win back your freedom. Rule the legendary world of Atlantis. Mine orichalc, and make use of unique buildings like bibliotheques and observatories.
Game.Genres: Construction and Management Simulation; Strategy; Vehicle Simulation

Game.Name: Zeus vs Monsters: Math Game for Kids
Game.Overview: Zeus vs. Monsters is a math game for kids with mixed mathematical operations - addition, subtraction, multiplication & division. With 50 levels and 10 bosses to defeat, this is a real math adventure. Introduce yourself to great fun and Greek mythology â€“ play Zeus vs. Monsters.

Game.Name: Z-Exemplar
Game.Overview: Z-Exemplar is a side-scrolling shooter in the tradition of R-Type, Gradius, Nemesis and other classic arcade games from the past. Borrowing its aesthetic from the computers of yesteryear (specifically the Sinclair ZX Spectrum) Z-Exemplar combines bright, bold, 8-bit pixel art with frantic action and an epic mission to conquer a galaxy of...

Game.Name: Zexion
Game.Overview:
As the space warrior Natu, travel to the planet known only as Cypher-X72 in search of the mysteriousÂ Zexion to save their home world Orinth from destruction!
Seek out technologically advanced items such as the Force Blaster - A gun that fires a spread of bullets that can push blocks and knock back enemies, and the Gravity Harness - A device that lets you fly short distances. You'll need artifacts such as these to unlock paths to delve deeper into Cypher-X72.
Dangers and horrors only spoken of in legend lie ahead, and you aren't the only one seeking Zexion! Galactic warlords and devious space pirates seek Zexion to further their domination of the galaxy! The odds are against you... Are you up to the challenge?
Vast Interconnected World!
Shoot in 8 directions independent of your movement!
Tons of Unique and Powerful Upgrades!
Unhinged Epic Boss Battles!
Many Secrets and Mysteries to uncover!
Features a built in Randomizer for even More Adventure!
(Note: Randomizer is unlocked upon completing the game.)

Game.Name: Zezenia Online
Game.Overview: Zezenia is a free to play 2D MMORPG with intense PvP wars & PvE combat. Choose from three classes and seven subclasses to discover a large map with four continents, hundreds of quests, a random equipment system & more.

Game.Name: Zhazari VR
Game.Overview: Zhazari is a game that will take you to a beautiful but dark world. You will come face to face with the menacing monsters that have taken over the kingdom, through the king's bad decisions. You are the last hope to bring peace back to the towns. Do you have the courage to stand up to fight?

Game.Name: ZHEROS
Game.Overview: ZHEROS is a new gen 3D beatâ€™em up, based on the genre hallmarks, above all: smashing hordes of enemies and punching stuff.

Game.Name: ZHP: Unlosing Ranger vs. Darkdeath Evilman
Game.Overview: The Unlosing Ranger is on his way to save Japan from Darkdeath Evilman when disaster strikes and he is struck by a car! With his dying breath he bequeaths his morphing belt to the true hero of the story: the most average boy in the universe. Will he rise to the challenge?

Game.Name: Ziggi's First ABCs
Game.Overview: Ziggi the dolphin invites the player to explore the ABCs through games, music, puzzle activities, and creative play in this cartoon-style animated game. After choosing the English or French version, the player is taken to the main page, where he can select from: Activities - clicking on each of the seven characters on the screen takes the player to a different spelling activity, including connect-the-letters, spelling words by selecting syllables, and matching pictures and words by their first letters Song - listen to and read along with Ziggy as she sings an original song Nursery Rhymes - read two original nursery rhymes and click on interactive objects for animations Word games - play 5 alphabet-oriented mini games, including an arcade game where the player has to catch flying words with the mouse and put them in a box Your Stories - the player can create his own pictures to make a story, using a selection of backgrounds, objects, characters, and sounds that can be linked to the objects. All the items can be resized and rotated, and pictures can be saved and printed, as can most pages in this game All the actions in Ziggi's First ABCs are accomplished with the mouse, clicking and dragging, aside from one activity that requires the player to hit the spacebar. Help is easily available, either from a life-preserver icon on the bottom of the screen, or audibly, by clicking on a character's speech bubble. The game is labeled for ages 4 - 6 (although many of the words are far beyond the kindergarten curriculum), and introduces the player to the concept of syllables, sounds and pronunciation of letters and words, connections between pictures and letters and between pictures and words.

Game.Name: Ziggy's Cosmic Adventures
Game.Overview:
Ziggy's Cosmic Adventures is a VR cockpit game combining ship management with action-arcade combat. You are a bounty hunter with possibly questionable morals, currently in possession of a powerful little alien that you may or may not have stolen/liberated from the evil Empire. They are in hot pursuit, and as the Empire closes in, you'll need to find a way to balance your ship's management and deal with their onslaught of attacks. Do you have what it takes to survive?
Immerse yourself in a cockpit packed full from floor to ceiling with distinct, physics-based interactive management systems. Though make sure to keep your eye on them all to improve your chances of survival!
Engage in thrilling dogfights as squads of enemies pursue you to re-capture the small green treasure aboard your ship - shoot bullets, launch bombs, and raise your shields. It's going to get bumpy!
Control the ship with a radical yet incredibly easy-to-use virtual flight stick design, dodge your way through many hazardous space environments, and don't forget to do a barrel roll!
Who could forget your cosmic friend, Ziggy?! This mysterious creature is a perfect fuel source. You can also play with them, use them as a resource, feed them, and most importantly pet them!
Throughout your journey, you will meet a wide cast of characters, both friend and foe alike. You will encounter new allies and friends in your quest to escape from the Empire that will help you to survive. But The Empress has sent her elite squad to stop you before you can realize your goal.
Fight your way through 13 unique levels, each with unique mechanics and obstacles to avoid. Unlock different path through the system each time by beating challenges and unlocking harder worlds as you progress throughout the adventure.
SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS:
MINIMUM: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system OS: Windows 10 64-bit Processor: Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600 Memory: 12 GB RAM Graphics: GTX 970 / RX 580 - 4GB VRAM Storage: 30 GB available space VR Support: SteamVR. Room Scale 2m by 1.5m area recommended. Seated and Stationary play supported.

Game.Name: Zombie Night Terror
Game.Overview:
Zombie Night Terror is a single-player action puzzle game. The player controls a spreading zombie outbreak in a pixel-art city plunged into chaos, with the objective of guiding the horde through urban environments and exterminating the human population. The story is presented through stage introductions, dialogue snippets, and environmental storytelling, gradually revealing how a strange new drug has unleashed the apocalypse.
The core gameplay is inspired by crowd-control puzzle mechanics, similar to that of Lemmings. Zombies move forward automatically and cannot be directly steered, so the player must assign mutations or abilities to alter their behavior and influence the flow of the horde. Mutations include turning a zombie into a crawler that climbs walls, a blocker that redirects others, or a jumper that clears gaps. These abilities cost DNA points, a resource harvested from consuming humans, which introduces a layer of management and prioritization.

Game.Name: Zombie Office Politics

Zombie Office Politics is an old-school three-quarter-view RPG set in an office where the staff are mysteriously turning into zombies. Forget an easy first day watching Health and Safety videos and getting your picture taken for your I.D. badge. Youâ€™re off on an epic journey through unexplored reaches of the office. Your quest - to halt the Zombie outbreak.
Battle Zombies using improvised everyday items found in the office, paper balls, dvds, paper clips and many more. Stock up on essential supplies such as coffee and donuts at vending machines, or even recycle your unwanted items into cool new stuff.
Zombie Office Politics blends humour, story and action with traditional RPG elements to provide a unique gaming experience.
Are you ready to save your work colleagues (even the ones that went back for their coats) and become a hero on your first day on the job?

Choose your team as the undead or a survivor. Enjoy their unique abilities, weapons, and challenges in this high-paced, action-packed thriller. The Teams As a survivor, unlock large arsenals of firearms, explosives and improvised melee weapons. Can you stop the waves of undead? Will you engage the horde head-on, or barricade and fortify while your friends play sniper? If all else fails, Panic! Then run as if your lives depend on itâ€¦ for they surely do.
As a zombie, youâ€™re free to hunt the living like the rabid beast you are. Feast upon their flesh and unlock your inner berserker. Heightened zombie night-vision gives you the upper hand in dark environments. Infect survivors as the carrier zombie (patient zero), to weaken their defenses, then sadistically watch them turn on each other. Use it all to your advantage to strategics, ambush, conquer and destroy your oblivious living counterparts. Gamemode Zombie Panic! Source hosts a variety of game modes for excellent replayability. Explore the zombie apocalypse with: Survival Mode: Put your ability to scavenge and survive to the test. Easily the top player choice. Objective Mode: Youâ€™re on a mission. Whether itâ€™s to escape or defeat the horde, youâ€™d better use your brainz to find those keys, get the power back on, hack that computer, and get to the chopper! Otherwiseâ€¦ I think you know what happens. Hardcore Mode: For experienced zombie connoisseurs, you and your teammates get to enjoy pitting yourselves against extra tough foes, and even rougher odds. Assault Mode: Capture the Point. Points are awarded for completing side objectives, adding to the overall score of the playersâ€™ team which in the end decides the victor.

Game.Name: Zombies Beyond Me
Game.Overview:
Survive and deceive your friends in a game of survival, deception, and social manipulation.
Work as a team to collect resources, weapons, and tools to escape Salty Islands alive. But remember that communication is an important factor, as there are traitors in your midst who will do anything to sabotage your escape and sacrifice the entire group of survivors.
You can play as a: Survivor: As a survivor, you must find or create the tools needed to fix the island's power generators and call for help over the town radio. â€¢ Search for the generators on a desolate map surrounded by water. â€¢ Mine rocks, cut down trees, hunt animals, and search for food in the abandoned buildings and houses on Salty Island. â€¢ Cooperate with your team to open locked vault doors and discover crates of precious items such as weapons, ammunition, and important resources. â€¢ Use different weapons with various mechanics to defend yourself, attack and shoot enemies (both natural and human). â€¢ Use your detective sense to find out who the traitors are, and don't be sorry: eliminate them the best way you can!
Traitor: As a traitor you must prevent the survivors from accomplishing the objectives, without being killed or recognized. â€¢ Use your private text chat to communicate with your fellow traitors. â€¢ Search for special traitor chests scattered around the map to collect important resources for your strategy to eliminate the survivors. Just don't get caught opening one! â€¢ Use traitor credits to perform special actions in the game, such as sabotaging the survivors' objectives and delaying them. â€¢ Blend in with the survivors, use your deception and lying techniques to make yourself look like one of them. But be careful, they are smart too.
Zombie: If you die, either as a survivor or a traitor, you get a second chance as a zombie. â€¢ Use your zombie form to get in the way of your opponents, traitors, or survivors. â€¢ You cannot speak, but you can be identified, so be careful. â€¢ Help your companions without being hindered by enemies as zombies!
Enjoy and have fun with lots of mechanics and features: Use various tools to communicate with your team. You can use a proximity voice chat and text chats.
Mistrust is part of the game. You can never trust someone 100%, even if they are your friend. Use this uncertainty to create the best strategy to win, even if you cannot trust anyone. Traitors can infiltrate easily, so you can't be too careful.
Be who you want to be! Use different outfits, skins, and backpacks to show your personality in the game. Jump into the game and face your obligations in the game with several classes, each with different advantages and disadvantages.
Have fun with your friends and other people. You can create your own server, private to your friends or not. Use this to create a greater atmosphere of tension and mistrust, and also to meet new people and make friends (or enemies)!

DEFUNCT GAME
En Masse Entertainment shut down the game servers on October 31, 2017, with no provision for migration or continuing with another publisher. It has no offline component, and is no longer playable.
----
Zombies Monsters Robots, better known as ZMR, is an online multiplayer third-person Shooter developed by Yingpei Games and published by En Masse entertainment. Zombies Monsters Robots is a seat-of-your-pants third-person shooter that pits players against everything but the kitchen sink of enemies, maps, and game modes. The invention of teleportation gates opened the door for extra-dimensional creatures to cross into our world. No place on Earth is safe from a host of bizarre enemies that will stop at nothing to see the end of all mankind. This is the world of ZMR.
-- Key Features --
Enemies Abound â€“ From the undead, to cyborgs, to supernatural, to mutants, to rival corporations, to dinosaurs with freakinâ€™ lasers strapped to their backs, prepare yourself for anything to pop up in your sights.
Complete Missions â€“ Complete specific objectives in-game to earn rewards like weapons, revive tokens, and gold bullets. New missions are announced every week, so stay informed.
Intense Multiplayer Combat â€“ Fight with up to 16 players in campaign, competitive, and wave-based survival modes across a wide range of maps.
Freakish Boss Fights â€“ Take on tough bosses of all types, from the terrifying to the truly bizarre. The tougher the challenge, the sweeter the victory.
Deep Customization Of Gear â€“ Upgrade your firepower with an arsenal of weapons, each of which includes up to 8 moddable slots, so you can tailor your mayhem however you like.
Monthly Content Updates â€“ ZMR also promises regular monthly updates with more enemies, weapons, maps, and modesâ€” which means that thereâ€™s always new battles to fight!

Game.Name: Zombies Must Die
Game.Overview: Zombies Must Die is a gloomy retro FPS featuring dozen handcrafted levels, a lot of zombies, and deadly weapons (crossbow included!). Do you aim good enough to headshot them all?

Game.Name: Zombie Solitaire

Game.Name: Zombies on a Plane
Game.Overview: Take on the role of the captain of a troubled jumbo jet carrying infected passengers intent on bringing the plane out of the sky, or pit yourself against hundreds of zombies in the interior of a jumbo jet or even walk along the outside as you fight to regain control as one of the passengers.

Game.Name: Zombies on a Plane: Deluxe Edition
Game.Overview:
Zombies on a Plane is an exciting new survival game in the sky. Take on the role of the captain of a troubled jumbo jet carrying infected passengers intent on bringing the plane out of the sky, or pit yourself against hundreds of zombies in the interior of a jumbo jet or even walk along the outside as you fight to regain control as one of the passengers in this innovative and interactive gaming experience like no other.
Use the plane as a weapon or shoot your way through the aisles as one of the last surviving passengers as you to fight to stay in the air against hordes of zombies at 30,000ft. As captain in control, players must maintain the health of vital key parts, such as the engines and rudder, by knocking the zombies off the plane. As a passenger, players use an assortment of weaponry and traps to halt the zombies' advance and can manually repair parts to keep the plane in the air. Key Features A Multitude of Modes - 6 different game modes to test your survival or flying skills, including modes like 'Defend the Cockpit' and 'Flight of 10 Waves'
High Replayability - 5 different characters and 3 planes to choose from, all with their own abilities and playstyles
Smart Gore System - Severe the limbs off zombies to slow them down and watch as they react
Zombie Variety - A multitude of intelligent zombie types to survive against, all with different playstyles
Unique Blend of Weaponry - 10 different weapons to unlock, including zombie shredding traps, with smart score-based weapon progression system
Rewards - Innovative combo reward system keeps the game fresh by rewarding players with large combos an array of exciting game changers
Manage the Plane - Repair parts to keep the plane in the air and keep doors sealed to prevent new spawn points opening up
Never-before-seen gameplay - Battle for control on top of a flying jumbo jet or knock zombies off the plane and watch them fall with glee as they realistically react to plane movement
High Visual Fidelity - Beautiful graphics powered by Unreal Engine 3 provide stunning and destructible game environments
Supports Steamworks features

Relive the classic experience of Zone of the Enders: The 2nd Runner in this full-length remaster of the fast-paced 3D robot action game, recreated in VR, native 4K, and in full surround sound. Enter JEHUTYâ€™s cockpit and fly through Martian skies!
The year is 2174 and the despotic BAHRAM military organisation is using new Orbital Frames robot technology to secure its grip on Mars and Earth. Seizing control of the JEHUTY Orbital Frame, the player is the last hope for the stricken planets. Strike deep at the heart of the BAHRAM army with unrivalled powers!

Game.Overview: It's a zoo out there, and you're in charge! Go wild with your imagination running the most exotic, fun and exciting zoo ever.

Game.Name: Zooicide
Game.Overview: Zooicide is a casual team-based multiplayer game featuring animals fighting against humans within a playfully dangerous environment, the zoo.

Game.Name: Zoo Life: Animal Park Game
Game.Overview: Zoo Life: Animal Park Game is a brand new zoo simulation game from Sparkling Society, famous for their city building games, where you can create the ZOO of your dreams! Build and manage your zoo and take care of your animals. Discover and collect all animal species to attract visitors from all over the world! Breed cute baby animals, design to your wishes and become the best zoo park manager ever! Join our community of millions of players with the most popular casual zoo building game series on mobile! Are you a fan of our city building games and looking for a refreshing challenge? Then Zoo Life: Animal Park Game is the perfect management game for you to pick up next! Wait no longer and build the best animal park that ever existed!

Game.Name: Zoological Era
Game.Overview: Creatures with magical abilities pose as divine beings and take over a temple. Play in Story mode or have quick matches.

Game.Name: Zool Redimensioned
Game.Overview:
The Ninja of the Nth Dimension is back! Explore vibrant retro landscapes, discover hidden secrets and take down menacing bosses in a modern reimagining of the classic action platforming adventure Zool.
Originally released by Gremlin Graphics in 1992 on the Amiga to critical acclaim, iconic gaming mascot Zool returns in Zool Redimensioned!
This brand-new reimagining of the classic action platforming adventure has been rebuilt from the ground up for modern audiences. Help Zool jump, spin and shoot his way across eight alien worlds, taking down menacing bosses and saving the universe from the nefarious influence of Krool.
Zoolâ€™s old school platforming action will challenge the most hardcore gamers, with modern enhancements that bring the game into the 21st century. Beat your speed run times, discover secrets hidden across every level, or go back in time and play the original classic game. Re-live the legend of the ninja that started it all!
Features Over 28 retro platforming challenges, all enhanced for the best possible experience Choose between two main game modes: Redimensioned for a more accessible modern experience, or Ultimate Ninja to experience a true hardcore challenge Trade blows with the dimension's most dangerous creatures in seven completely redesigned boss fights Discover new secrets, challenges and extras across your adventure, with over 25 achievements to unlock Enhanced quality-of-life options, including a level select screen, checkpoints, accessibility options and more Play the original Mega Drive version for a truly authentic retro adventure
Sumo Digital Academy Zool Redimensioned has been rebuilt from scratch by the Sumo Digital Academy, a talent development programme focused on creating new pathways into the games industry. With guidance from the developers of the 1992 original at Gremlin Graphics, weâ€™ve retained the spirit that makes Zool a cult classic, while adding mechanics weâ€™ve loved from the past 29 years of fantastic platforming games. The result is Zool Redimensioned, a game that transcends time and space - donâ€™t miss out on this classic retro adventure!

Game.Name: Zooma
Game.Overview: Zooma is a virtual adventure in which you will have to be smart, demonstrate your ability for rapid decision-making, and exhibit significant accuracy and coordination skills. Check out what happens if you mix shooting, puzzles, and classic match-three in virtual reality.

Game.Name: Zoombinis
Game.Overview: In the entertaining and educational game Zoombinis, players guide the little blue creatures through fun and increasingly challenging puzzles on their way to a new home.

Game.Name: Zoombinis: Island Odyssey
Game.Overview: Zoombinis: Island Odyssey is the third game in the Zoombinis series of educational games. In this game the zoombinis return home after finding out that the Bloats have left the island after doing much ecological damage to it. Now they try to restore the balance and save the zerbles, an endangered species, by re-establishing their food chain and do zerbles genetics research. The player starts out with creating an party of twelve volunteer zoombinis. The zoombinis can be customized with different feet, eyes, nose color and hairstyle. Once a party has been created it's time to set sail to Zoombini Island.

Game.Name: Zoombinis: Logical Journey
Game.Overview: Logical Journey of the Zoombinis is an educational game designed to promote logical thinking in children of all ages. When the Zoombinis home, Zoombini Isle, is taken over by creatures called Bloats, they decide to escape to a new home. But they can only 16 at a time, and they must cross many obstacles that require logic to get past. It's up to you to get past all the puzzles to get all of the Zoombinis to their new home.

Game.Name: Zoombinis: Mountain Rescue
Game.Overview: The Zoombinis get into trouble again when they seek shelter in a mountain cave from a storm. They find some strange creatures called Boolies who live in the city of Booliewood. The storm has scattered them across the land, and their leader, the Grand Boolie Boolie, has disappeared. You have to find 400 Boolies in order to restore their master. There's nine puzzles and three levels of difficulty. Each challenge tests mathematical thinking skills like organizing information, reasoning with evidence, and systematic testing. It uses information-age logic skills used for writing computer programs, organizing data, working with spreadsheets, and more. It has a new 3D look, teaches advanced concepts like networks and binary numbers and has even more wacky characters and adventures.

Game.Name: Zoo Park
Game.Overview: Care for over 40 different animals from all four corners of the Earth whilst running a professional programme of rescue, rehabilitation, research and conservation.

Game.Name: Zoo Rampage
Game.Overview: Did you ever wonder how it was like to be on the other side of the fence? In this zoo you can figure it out - take control over the whole area and destroy what kept you in prison for so long.

Game.Name: Zoo Tycoon
Game.Overview:
Zoo Tycoon is, as the title implies, a simulation game that allows the player to build and manage a zoo. The new manager starts from nothing, being given just a grass field and an entrance sign for the future zoo. He will then have to purchase animals, place them in exhibits, care for their health, and not forget about the other kind of animals - the visitors. To keep them happy, the manager should make the zoo comfortable, open restaurants, gift stands, and pet houses for children.
The game features over forty animal species. It also provides background information about the animals - their classes, origins, habits, etc.

Game.Name: Zoo Tycoon 2
Game.Overview:
Zoo Tycoon 2 is the sequel to Zoo Tycoon. The sequel updates the graphics, but keeps much of the original gameplay the same.
You start with an open field and must build it up into a zoo. Create exhibits and populate them with animals. Build amenities and concession stands to keep visitors happy in between exhibits. Happy visitors will donate more money to your zoo so you can make it better. However, you have much more freedom in exhibit creation. You don't even need fences; a moat or ditch will suffice, as this technique is popular at real high profile zoos. There are also more animals and attractions to place in your zoo, and animal habitats look as realistic as the cartoony graphics style will allow.

Game.Name: Zoo Tycoon 2: African Adventures
Game.Overview:
Zoo Tycoon 2: African Adventure is the second expansion pack (after Endangered Species) to Zoo Tycoon 2. The player is now able to introduce his visitors to the natural environment of African animals. The game adds eight biomes, twenty new animal species, new buildings, objects, and gifts (including a desert theme pack).
Players can view the animals in their exotic habitats in Zookeeper, Zoo Guest and Photo Safari modes. The safari experience can be extended by venturing into the zoo on a tour in a new jeep that has optional animal-skin paint jobs. There are new scenarios and challenges awaiting the players in "Africa".
The twenty new animal species include aardvark, barbary ape, caracal, masai giraffe, pygmy hippo, secretary bird, white rhino, wildebeest, and others. The eight new biomes are: alpine, desert, grassland, savannah, scrub, temperate forest, tropical rainforest, and wetlands.

Game.Name: Zoo Tycoon 2: Endangered Species
Game.Overview: As the first expansion to Zoo Tycoon 2, Zoo Tycoon 2: Endangered Species adds 20 rare animals to the game, as well as new features such as vehicle tours, sky trams, and elevated walkways and observation decks. Also included are a series of new challenges relating to the preservation of endangered animals, and many new zoo objects and game enhancements.

Game.Name: Zoo Tycoon 2: Extinct Animals
Game.Overview:
Zoo Tycoon 2: Extinct Animals is the fourth expansion to Zoo Tycoon 2. As the title indicates, it offers the possibility to add animals to your zoo that are extinct in real life. These animals are not simply for sale, you'll have to dig for fossils on the terrain of an existing or new zoo (with an upgradeable fossil detector), and bring them to life in your lab with a few mini-games. First you'll have to put the fossils together like a jigsaw puzzle. In a push-the-right-button-at-the-right-time mini-game you can then determine the strength and health of your new creation. The complexity of the jigsaw puzzles and the mini-game gradually increases.
The expansion adds 34 animals, from dodo and American mastodon to saber-toothed cat, Stegosaurus and Tyrannosaurus Rex to the zoo catalogue. Most animals can live together with today's species peacefully, but carnivorous dino's will eat your other animals if you're not careful. Some extinct animals can break free from their cages, which causes a panic among the visitors and can create a lot of damage. You can either tranquillize them yourself in a mini-game as soon as this happens or hire a team to do it for you. The formerly extinct animals can also get ill. By taking samples of their surroundings you can find a cure.
The game also adds new buildings, objects, staff members and challenges. Most of them are unlocked by finishing certain campaigns.

Game.Name: Zoo Tycoon 2: Marine Mania
Game.Overview: Zoo Tycoon 2: Marine Mania is the third expansion pack for the video game Zoo Tycoon 2. The expansion focuses around marine animals, as did the Marine Mania expansion for the first Zoo Tycoon game.

Game.Name: Zoo Tycoon 2: Ultimate Collection
Game.Overview: Zoo Tycoon 2: Ultimate Collection is a Compilation game, developed by Blue Fang Games and published by Microsoft Game Studios, which was released in 2008.

Game.Name: Zoo Tycoon: Complete Collection
Game.Overview: An insidiously addictive simulation game, Zoo Tycoon allows players to create their own zoo, but not just any zoo. It's completely free-form: Start with fences for your exhibits, then pick animals and give them toys, foliage, and anything else you want. For your customers, you can lay down paths to lead them around, then add food stands, amusement rides, even maps and trash cans. Not sure what you need? The zoo advisors will tell you how to make the animals happy, and the customers themselves will tell you what they're looking for, be it snacks, more animals, or anything else. There's also a vast amount of background information on each critter--its diet, its habitat, etc.--which can be useful when you're adding a macrauchenia or a Loch Ness Monster. In all, you can choose over 100 animals, plus countless habitat and park embellishments.
Game.Genres: Compilation; Construction and Management Simulation; Education; Strategy

Game.Name: Zoo Tycoon: Dino Digs
Game.Overview:
This expansion to Zoo Tycoon, the zoo management game, allows you to maintain a zoo full of dinosaurs. 20 different dinos can be added to your zoo, including the T-Rex and the Velociraptor plus creatures from the Ice Age, such as the Sabertooth Tiger and the Wooly Mammoth.
To help contain the new 'giant' creatures, new park features allow you to build bigger and stronger cages. Use electric fences to hold the dino's inside (just pray no-one turns out the lights) while, to attract people to your zoo, you can build around the cages to create a Dinosaur like environment, with Volcanoes and tall grass/ice terrain to help make the creatures feel more at home. You can also build normal structures for the usual zoo animals (Elephant, monkey, etc.) to create the ultimate animal parade.
Six scenarios are also included, allowing you to take on a task of keeping the budget in check, taking good care of the employees and feed the hungry Dino's and other animals while paying for expenses.

Game.Name: Zoo Tycoon: Marine Mania
Game.Overview: This is the second expansion pack (after Dinosaur Dig) to the zoo-managing simulation Zoo Tycoon. New in this expansion is the addition of over 20 various marine animals, including dolphins, giant squids, whales, some amphibious animals like sea lions, etc. Those animals will require special aquatic exhibits that you'll have to construct, controlling the water depth that is most suitable for the animal inside the exhibit. You'll also be able to present aquatic shows of dolphins, killer whales, and other animals. There are 10 new scenarios added to the main game, and new objects.

Game.Name: Zoo Tycoon: Ultimate Animal Collection
Game.Overview:
Zoo Tycoon: Ultimate Animal Collection is a re-release of the 2013 title Zoo Tycoon. This re-release has had a lot of new content added and several gameplay features changed.
The Ultimate Animal Collection contains almost 200 animal species to adopt, while the original version contained around 110. These new creatures are mainly from South America and Australia, two continents not covered before. The game adds 10 new campaign levels and a new challenge zoo.

Game.Name: Zoo Vet
Game.Overview:
Lions, tigers and bears... oh, my! In this game you'll get up close and personal with wild animals, because you are one of their doctors! Assume the role of a zoo veterinarian where you can pet, talk to and treat all types of animals in need of help. Every type of animal imaginable is a guest at this world-class zoo and you'll have the opportunity to meet dozens of them in Zoo Vet.
There are several difficulty modes to choose from. You'll receive help along the way from zookeepers and other veterinarians on staff. Look up facts and play animal trivia to learn more about all of the animals. Earn up to 1,000 per case. The number of points determines what trophies and awards you win. If you do well enough, you will unlock more challenging cases and the praise of your co-workers. Win the game by getting a permanent job at the zoo.
Travel to each of the animal habitats to perform examinations and evaluate the problems. Use 40 medically-accurate tools - even perform surgeries when needed! Go back to your office to relax, play bonus mini-games or to do research.
The game features a simple point-and-click interface, rendered 3D graphics and voices by real actors and actresses. Zoo Vet is a family-oriented game for all ages.

Game.Name: Zorbus
Game.Overview: Zorbus is a fantasy-themed, tile-based, turn-based, traditional roguelike game.

Game.Name: Zordak
Game.Overview:
You wake up from an unexpectedly long cryosleep, only to discover that this place is not what it's supposed to be.
Everyone is dead and the facility has been abandoned.
You seem to be the only survivor.
You now have to do what you must to survive and embark on your journey in the search for another human being.

Game.Name: Zorg The Typing Warrior
Game.Overview: Meet Zorg, an out of it barbarian who loves loads of drinks and adventures. An indie game in which your ability to type fast is the best weapon to win.

Game.Name: Zoria: Age of Shattering Prologue
Game.Overview: A squad-based tactical RPG with fluid turn-based combat, outpost, and follower management, set in the expansive Fantasy world of Zoria. Lead a team of four heroes with their unique skills and perks. Every team member contributes to undertaken battles.

Game.Name: Zork: Grand Inquisitor
Game.Overview: Join forces with Dungeon Master Dalboz and travel throughout the Underground Empire's many locations, such as Hades, Flood Control Dam #3 and The Dungeon Master's Lair.

Game.Name: Zork III: The Dungeon Master
Game.Overview: Youâ€™re on the threshold of a whole new experience, for ahead of you is the extraordinary anthology of the Great Underground Empire. Once you step through the door to Zork, you leave the world of arcade games and trite fantasies behind and enter the dimension of your imagination. Every plot, every puzzle, every personality has been honed and perfected to make your experience uniquely realistic and involving. The Zork saga is text adventuring at its finest. Welcome to the Underground. Your greatest challenge lies ahead â€“ and downwards.

Game.Name: Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz
Game.Overview: Youâ€™re on the threshold of a whole new experience, for ahead of you is the extraordinary anthology of the Great Underground Empire. Once you step through the door to Zork, you leave the world of arcade games and trite fantasies behind and enter the dimension of your imagination. Every plot, every puzzle, every personality has been honed and perfected to make your experience uniquely realistic and involving. The Zork saga is text adventuring at its finest. Welcome to the Underground. Your greatest challenge lies ahead â€“ and downwards.

Game.Name: Zork Nemesis: The Forbidden Lands
Game.Overview:
In the last days of the Great Underground Empire, four of the Empire's greatest Alchemists disappeared into the Forbidden Lands on the day of the Solar Eclipse, supposedly searching for the secret of the Quintessena, the Eternal Life. An imperial spy, Bivotar, was dispatched to locate them. He never returned. Now, the task has fallen onto you.
You soon discover that the Alchemists are dead, slain by a horrible demon known only as the Nemesis. You manage to get on the Nemesis' nerves, and soon find yourself allied with the spirits of the dead Alchemists, attempting to finish their work before the Nemesis can finish you. But all is not as it seems, and as you unravel the secrets of the past through old letters and ghostly flashbacks, you begin to realize the full horror of the events which transpired under the Eclipse all those years ago.
Zork Nemesis: The Forbidden Lands is a graphical first person adventure game in the style of Myst, mixing logic puzzles with live-action FMV sequences which advance the story. The player views each location from a first-person perspective, and can rotate the camera 180 degrees to get a full view of your surroundings.
Like other Zork installments, the game contains humorous elements, but in general its story and atmosphere are darker, including images and themes such as decapitated heads and human sacrifice.

Game.Name: Zork: The Great Underground Empire
Game.Overview: Youâ€™re on the threshold of a whole new experience, for ahead of you is the extraordinary anthology of the Great Underground Empire. Once you step through the door to Zork, you leave the world of arcade games and trite fantasies behind and enter the dimension of your imagination. Every plot, every puzzle, every personality has been honed and perfected to make your experience uniquely realistic and involving. The Zork saga is text adventuring at its finest. Welcome to the Underground. Your greatest challenge lies ahead â€“ and downwards.

The year in 1066. You're a private, 7th class, in the Inquisition Guard. After getting relieved of your post at the Port Foozle Inquisition Gift Kiosk, you see the Pastor of Disaster, the Minister of Sinister, the Grand Inquisitor. It looks like he has a job for you. Yes, you. After asking about other, ANY other, guards to go instead, you have your orders. Sigh. Very well. Archaeologists have unearthed a tunnel that seems to lead to a new section of the Great Underground Empire or GUE. You are to enter this tunnel and explore the Great Underground Empire. You'll be back in no time. You hope.

Zotrix is a modern take on the classic arcade shooter.
Defend humanity from the forces of Zotrix!
Zotrix is an arcade space shooter inspired by early shooter games on arcade machines from 80's and early 90's. Designed for all generations it contains missions with nice and colorful enemies while focused on the arcade element of the gameplay.
You dive into deep space escorting a cargo ship from your fleet. Quickly you realize you're within the boundaries of enemy territory. Victory doesn't come easy as you have to earn every single space credit out there fighting in over 50 missions.
Build your strategy by carefully choosing routes from your space station towards another and have your take in every mission. Each mission will pit a challenge in front of you and most of the missions will get you to face a bigger and badder alien ships.

Game.Name: Zulu's Zoo
Game.Overview: The US government starts a competition between zoological parks to win a grant of one million dollars, prompting the park manager Zulu to inspect her establishment, making all kinds of reforms and improvements to the attractions. Zulu's Zoo is a hidden object game with a zoological theme. As Zulu, the objective is to manage a park by cleaning cages, feeding animals and performing other similar tasks. The park's locations are shown as mostly static scenes, accessed through an overhead map. The goal of each location is displayed at the wooden bottom interface, alongside a star-shaped hint button and the list of remaining things to be found. Most of the time, the goal is to find and click on all the items listed at the bottom. Some locations have other gameplay variations, where the objective is to feed all the captive animals by dragging and dropping the appropriate food icons on them. In some instances, the screen is all blurry with the exception of a mouse-controlled camera viewfinder, and the goal is snap to a number of pictures of the animals listed at the bottom. In other scenes, the objective is to clean an area by dragging and dropping all the junk inside a trash bin, or by using a bug spray to kill all pests. The hint button costs one star per use, and highlights the position of one of the required items. After completing each screen, a trivia item about animals is displayed and the player receives a number of stars based on how fast the scene was completed and the quantity of hints used. Besides the required animals and objects, each scenario has stars to be collected as well. They have two purposes, serving as the help system by accumulating uses for the hint button, and giving access to the test that will increase Zulu's rank and give access to new locations. The tests cost a certain number of stars, and are association tasks where the player must connect animals to their correct habitat, food type and so on. Stars can also be received after completing one of the mini-games, gradually available through the map screen. They are common implementations of classic games, like concentration with matching animal pictures, a guessing game where the player must click on the name of the correct animal by analyzing portions of its picture and a conveyor belt puzzle where food has to be redirected on tracks towards the correct animal.

Game.Name: Zuma Deluxe
Game.Overview:
Zuma Deluxe is an Aztec-themed action puzzler. The goal: eliminate all the balls before they reach the skull. Balls roll down a track towards this skull and the player-controlled frog-shaped idol must shoot balls toward them to stop them, earning points. Using the mouse to rotate the frog and clicking to fire, the player needs to create rows of three or more of the same color balls to eliminate them.
The catch is that each track is shaped differently. Part of the track may block others so that if the track is filled with balls, the ones behind some may be unreachable. Fortunately, the player has up to four lives, a rarity in many puzzle games.

Game.Name: Zuma Legend VR
Game.Overview: Have you ever play Zuma in VR, and what if i tell you it is a First-Person perspective game? You will definitely have a lot of fun with this game shooting balls as if in reality, Now it comes, Let's go.

Game.Name: Zuma's Revenge!
Game.Overview:
Zuma's Revenge is the sequel to Zuma Deluxe. As in the previous game, the main goal is to clear a series of marble strings by matching three or more balls of the same color. The spheres roll on twisting tracks that occupy most of the screen, appearing from one side and moving towards the gaping mouth of a golden skull. The player controls a frog that is either stationed near the tracks or moving sideways at the bottom. The amphibian holds one of the colored balls in its open mouth, and a reserve one inside its body.
The main Adventure Mode is divided in sequential zones, each with several levels. The main objective of each level is to aim and shoot at the moving lines to make three-of-a-kind color matches and fill a meter at the top to finish. If three or more balls enter the exit hole, the player loses one life and the level has to be replayed. When all lives are spent, the whole zone has to be restarted from the latest automatic checkpoint, usually at mid-point.

"Gu Jian Qi Tan: Where Are the Lute Heart and Sword Soul Now?" (Gu Jian Qi Tan), independently developed by Shanghai Zhulong, a subsidiary of Wangyuan Shengtang, and officially released in July 2010, is China's first fully voiced, large-scale, 3D Xianxia single-player role-playing game.
The game adopts an alternate historical setting, incorporating numerous authentic cultural and geographical features, and skillfully presents these landscapes, imbued with a rich ancient charm and Chinese flavor. The game employs a soft color scheme, realistic textures, and life-size scene modeling, complemented by procedural support such as fog effects and depth of field, creating a world of elegant style and rich ancient charm. The game's unique combat system, star system, achievements system, and specialized assistance system have also garnered rave reviews from players.
The immortal mountains stretch thousands of feet, yet the sun and moon remain unaware of their decline. Entering the mortal world, carrying a fierce ancient sword, the enigmatic young man Baili Tusu encounters the gentle girl Feng Qingxue, the young scholar Fang Lansheng, the wandering roamer Yin Qianshang, the mysterious woman Hongyu, and the charming girl Xiang Ling, who falls head over heels for him. Thus begins a legendary journey in search of rebirth and the meaning of life. A lingering celestial sound passed down from ancient times, a magnificent ancient ruin, a dreamlike and beautiful princess, a distant and turbulent sea, a fragrant dream paradise, and an unimaginable and extraordinary love story will quietly unfold before everyone's eyes. Heaven and earth, destinies intertwine, and a seemingly unreachable destination awaits Baili Tusu. What bizarre fate awaits him? The Steam version of "Gujian Qitan" includes all game DLC, including: 1. Eternal Sword Spirit 2. Past Events of Tianyong 3. Floating Lanterns on the Other Shore 4. Drunken Dreams of Jianghu 5. Peach Blossom Fantasy

Game.Name: å¤å‰‘å¥‡è°­äºŒ(GuJian2)
Game.Overview:
"Gujian Qitan II: Eternal Night, Beginning of the Blue Sky" (Gujian Qitan II) is a large-scale 3D Xianxia single-player role-playing game developed independently by Shanghai Zhulong, a subsidiary of Wangyuan Shengtang. As the second installment in the Gujian single-player series, it was released simultaneously in Mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong on August 18, 2013. "Gujian Qitan II" challenges the traditional Chinese single-player experience, employing real-time combat and cinematic presentation techniques, while also incorporating numerous breakthroughs and innovations, setting a new standard for domestic single-player games.
Where are the Twelve Jade Towers now? How many times have dust drifted and the sea dried up?
Le Wuyi, a cheerful young man skilled in the art of Yan, leaves home for a chance journey, encountering Wen Renyu, the Tiangang of Baicao Valley, Xia Yize, a disciple of Taihua Mountain, and Aruan, a beautiful girl with a mysterious background. These four are brought together by a strange fate. Amidst a terrifying conspiracy, disaster strikes again, and amidst unpredictable fate, the road ahead is long and arduous! Can they clear the fog and reveal the path forward?
The snowy northern borderlands towering above the heavens, the bustling dance halls draped with heavy curtains, the devout priests bowing in ancient temples, the desolate desert beneath the setting sun... Time flows like a river, and everything ends before it even begins.
Having traversed vast rivers and mountains, explored the azure skies and the underworld, all that is desired is finally within reach. But what will fate reveal?
The Steam version of "Gujian Qitan II" includes all the game's DLC, including:
1. Night Talk Story - Crown of the Sky
2. Side Stories - The True Voice of the Ten Demons, Beauty Gifted to the Beautiful, and Chess Meets a Rival
3. Side Story - Moon Over the Sea
4. Side Story - Frost Blade Begins
5. Side Story - Hidden Dragon in the Abyss
Continuing the series's alternate history setting, this game incorporates numerous authentic cultural and geographical features, featuring unique combat systems, weapon systems, star essence systems, achievements systems, home systems, and other support systems.
1. Combat System: Gujian Qitan II features a real-time combat system, offering a highly flexible combat experience that makes combat incredibly engaging and enjoyable.
2. Weapon Upgrades: Gain experience points with various items. Once you reach the upgrade requirement, you can upgrade your weapon with the help of specific items.
3. Spirit Stone Inlaying: Item Crafting allows you to refine Spirit Stones with different functions. Weapons and equipment inlaid with Spirit Stones greatly increase their power. The materials for refining Spirit Stones are mostly obtained from items dropped by monsters.
4. Star Essence System: Learn a wealth of skills and strengthen your abilities through the Star Essence system. Powerful and dazzling special skills and spells are learned and enhanced by filling up Star Essence. Experience a variety of Star Essence gameplay.
5. Costume System: As the story progresses, you can obtain unique costumes for the main character. You can also find costumes in treasure chests scattered throughout the game. Opening a mysterious treasure chest might reveal a beautiful outfit.
6. Item Synthesis: Defeating monsters not only boosts your character's combat experience, but also grants loot such as special materials. Through the Item Synthesis system, specific materials can be combined to create new items.
7. Treasure Hunting: The world of Gu Jian is filled with treasures left behind by past generations. With the help of the Treasure Hunting system, players can uncover these treasures one by one and collect them for themselves, becoming a treasure collector in the game!
8. Achievements: Challenges encompass combat, mazes, monster capture, and the Heroes' Ranking. These diverse achievements will add even more excitement to your adventure.
9. Homesteading: Harvest food and medicinal herbs through planting and breeding in your fields or ponds. Crafting these precious materials into items will become indispensable aids on your journey.
10. Cooking: In the kitchen of the Homesteading system, you can showcase your cooking skills, experimenting with different combinations of ingredients, creating unique dishes, and obtaining exclusive recipes.
